en: Black‑and‑white vintage street view of a small European town. A gently curving road leads uphill between stone and half‑timbered houses with tiled roofs. A man with a cane walks in the foreground, while a horse‑drawn cart and several people stand further up the street. On the hillside above the houses are trees, the tower and spire of a church with a cross on top, and, slightly behind, the crenellated ruins of a medieval castle. The edges of the image show damage or unexposed film, suggesting an old photographic postcard or plate.
